beats.event: Nala and Damayanti fall in love via a magical swan messenger
Four gods arrive at Damayanti's svayamvara intending to woo her
Damayanti chooses Nala; the gods bless the couple with boons
They marry, have twin children, and reign happily for twelve years
Kali, angered at losing Damayanti, possesses Nala
Pushkara challenges Nala to dice; Nala loses his entire kingdom
Stripped of possessions, the couple flees into the forest
Enchanted birds steal Nala's last garment, leaving him naked
Guilt-stricken Nala abandons Damayanti asleep in the night
Damayanti endures python, hunter's assault, and elephant stampede
Damayanti taken in as chambermaid by the Chedi queen mother
Nala saves snake-king Karkotaka; turned hunchback, Kali expelled
Disguised as Bahuka, Nala serves King Rituparna of Ayodhya
Brahmins locate Nala; Damayanti stages a false svayamvara to lure him
On the rushed chariot ride, Nala masters numbers; Kali fully departs
Divine signs confirm Nala's identity and Damayanti's chastity; reunited
Nala defeats Pushkara, forgives him, and reclaims his kingdom
